# Filter rows for Team Liquigas and Rabobank
liquigas_row = df[df['Team'] == 'Liquigas']
rabobank_row = df[df['Team'] == 'Rabobank']

# Extract points for each team - use the exact column name from df
# First, let's check what the actual column name is
column_name = df.columns[df.columns.str.contains('UCI')][0]

liquigas_points = liquigas_row[column_name].iloc[0] if not liquigas_row.empty else 0
rabobank_points = rabobank_row[column_name].iloc[0] if not rabobank_row.empty else 0

# Calculate the difference
answer = liquigas_points - rabobank_points
